toegepas.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
toegepas.voor: Die woordskaal is maklik om te lees en die lynskaal
toegepas.na: Die woordskaal is maklik om te lees, en die lynskaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences, each with its own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Die woordskaal is ...' and 'die lynskaal is ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each side has its own subject and verb, so the comma is required and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'Albei kan ... staan' and 'baie kaarte dra ...' each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining 'Albei kan op een kaart staan' and 'baie kaarte dra net een van die twee'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full clauses with their own subjects and verbs; the comma is required and nothing else moves.

toegepas.voor: Sy stukkies word korter of langer
toegepas.na: Die stukke word korter of langer
toegepas.rede_vinder: Sentence-initial 'Sy' can read as 'she', and 'stukkies' differs from 'stukke' used for the same parts in the lynskaal block and the glossary.
toegepas.fout: Sentence-initial 'Sy' can briefly read as 'she', and 'stukkies' differs from 'stukke'/'stuk' used for the same parts elsewhere in the lesson and glossary.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die stukke' removes the stumble and matches the lesson's own term without changing what is said.

laat_vaar.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Dra net een van die twee' reads stiff for a map having only one of the two scales; 'het' is the natural Grade 6 word, and the next block's heading and closing sentence keep 'dra'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dra' is natural for a map carrying a scale and is the verb the lesson uses in the next heading and closing sentence, so swapping it here is a lateral move that breaks that consistency.
